estimators.ratio: G/S, G/M and M/S: the ratio of two arms' means of stress-ng's own per-phase rate (or wall clock), with a two-sample BCa 95% interval over the run's rounds
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

provenance.diagnostic: an engine increment against its merge base and stock, outside METHODOLOGY.md's pre-registration (docs/BENCHMARKING.md, the increment's pre-registration)
